newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end slightly down, banks active.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end slightly down, banks active.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended down in profit-taking on Thursday, with bank stocks among the most active as a World Bank report on Indonesia was seen having little impact on the sector, brokers and analysts said.
The Jakarta composite index closed down 2.34 points, or 0.33 percent, at 708.45 points after touching a day low of 706.08 points. Advancers led decliners by 72 to 65 with 68 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was estimated at 652 billion rupiah against some 554 billion rupiah on Wednesday.
